title: The Earth and the Sky
subtitle: 考点：一般现在时 / The Earth is a planet

dialogue.t: It is a planet in outer space.
Can we see the moon in the daytime?
Sometimes. We can see it in the sky on clear days.
We usually see stars at night, not in the daytime.
The sun is too bright in the daytime.
